NUTRITION
  ENERGY target:
    calories 1650
    protein_g 120
    carbs_g 140
    fat_g 60
  MEAL_TIMING:
    - distribute 3..4 meals per day
    - include protein 25..40g per meal
    - pre_workout 20..40g carbs + 20..30g protein 60..120 minutes before training
    - post_workout 25..35g protein + 30..50g carbs within 2 hours after training
    - avoid fasted high_intensity sessions to reduce hypoglycaemia risk
  CARB_QUALITY:
    - prioritize low_gi carbs: oats, quinoa, brown_rice, lentils, beans, chickpeas, yogurt, berries, apples, pears, non_starchy_veg
    - limit high_gi refined carbs and added sugars
    - include 8..12g fiber per meal (25..35g daily)
  PROTEIN_QUALITY:
    - lean sources: poultry, fish, eggs, greek_yogurt, cottage_cheese, tofu, tempeh, legumes, whey_isolate
  FAT_QUALITY:
    - emphasize mono_polyunsaturated: olive_oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty_fish
    - limit saturated_fat and avoid trans_fats
  HYDRATION:
    - water 2.0..2.7L daily
    - during training 200..400ml per 15 minutes as needed
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    - prioritize magnesium, vitamin_d, potassium, omega_3
    - include leafy_greens, cruciferous_veg, nuts_seeds, fatty_fish
  GLUCOSE_MONITORING:
    - check glucose pre_workout; if <90 mg/dL include 15..20g fast_acting carbs
    - carry fast_acting carbs during sessions
    - monitor 2 hours post_meal and adjust carbs to keep postprandial <140..180 mg/dL per clinician guidance
  MEAL_EXAMPLES:
    - breakfast: greek_yogurt 200g + berries 100g + oats 40g + chia 10g
    - lunch: grilled_chicken 120g + quinoa 120g cooked + mixed_veg 200g + olive_oil 1 tbsp
    - snack: whey_isolate 30g + apple 1 medium + almonds 15g
    - dinner: salmon 140g + lentils 150g cooked + spinach 150g + olive_oil 1 tsp
  WEEKLY_ADJUSTMENTS:
    - if average weekly weight loss <0.25% bodyweight, reduce carbs by 15..25g daily
    - if average weekly weight loss >1% bodyweight or energy low, add 15..25g carbs on training days
    - keep protein >=1.6g/kg and distribute evenly
  BEHAVIOURS:
    - plan meals and shop with a list
    - eat vegetables first, protein second, starch last
    - slow eating: meals last 15..20 minutes
    - limit alcohol to <=1 drink on <=2 days per week, never pre_workout
  MEDICATION_NOTES:
    - continue metformin as prescribed; coordinate changes with clinician
    - metformin lowers hepatic glucose output with low hypoglycaemia risk, but monitor when training volume increases
    - report any dizziness or symptomatic lows to clinician promptly
